description: This file defines the EmailQueueService class, which manages email queuing, sending, and status updates within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for adding emails to the queue, sending individual or all pending emails, and changing email statuses, utilizing dependencies such as EmailQueueDao, EmailService, and traits for logging and transaction management.

classes.name: EmailQueueService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing email queue operations, including enqueuing emails, sending them, and updating their statuses through interactions with DAO and email services.

methods.name: getEmailQueueDao
methods.description: Returns the EmailQueueDao instance, instantiating it if not already created.

methods.name: getEmailService
methods.description: Returns the EmailService instance, instantiating it if not already created.

methods.name: addToQueue
methods.description: Creates a new Mail object with provided parameters and saves it to the email queue.

methods.name: sendSingleMail
methods.description: Sends an individual email identified by mail ID, updating its status based on success or failure.

methods.name: resetEmailService
methods.description: Resets the EmailService message fields to empty or default values.

methods.name: changeMailStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a Mail object and sets the sent timestamp if applicable.

methods.name: sendAllPendingMails
methods.description: Iterates through all pending emails and attempts to send each one.
